name: ms4-mcp-server

tools.name: ms4.chat.send@v1
tools.gate_rationale: Open data-plane inference only; serialized argument bytes are capped and downstream runtime controls still apply.

idempotency.rationale: No MCP request-level deduplication is provided.

cancellation.rationale: The MCP invocation cannot be cancelled after dispatch.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.update@v1
tools.gate_rationale: Explicit confirmation is required before changing the contained Hermes installation; target and single-flight guards remain defense in depth.

idempotency.rationale: Repeating the same target is protected by the updater's single-flight and already-current no-op contracts.

cancellation.rationale: The MCP invocation and its background update job cannot be cancelled after dispatch.

tools.description: Trigger an idempotent in-place Hermes upgrade (editable git checkout or PyPI wheel) in the MS4 contained .venv.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.update.status@v1

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.submit@v1
tools.gate_rationale: Denied until can_mutate_world=false is an execution fence for every worker tool call and admission bounds the number of spawned workers.

idempotency.rationale: A retry can enqueue another job; MCP does not deduplicate requests.

cancellation.rationale: No job is admitted while the runtime gate is denied.

tools.description: Submit a Double Agent background job (foreground/background lobe coordination).

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.status@v1
tools.description: Current snapshot for one Double Agent job, including is_stale and last_safe_user_status.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.list@v1
tools.description: List Double Agent jobs filtered by conversation_id and state.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.events@v1
tools.description: Recent allowlisted lifecycle events for a job. Anti-hallucination: no raw model tokens.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.cancel@v1
tools.gate_rationale: An intentionally ungated safety stop targets one safe internal job id; it may update that job, cancel its HLI trace, and terminate only its worker.

idempotency.rationale: Repeating cancellation for an already-finished job returns its terminal snapshot without another effect.

cancellation.rationale: The cancellation invocation itself cannot be cancelled after dispatch.

tools.description: Cancel a running Double Agent job.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.mark_stale@v1
tools.gate_rationale: An intentionally ungated safety stop targets one safe internal job id; it updates that job's durable state and may terminate only its worker.

idempotency.rationale: A repeat can update the stored stale reason, so identical effect is not guaranteed.

cancellation.rationale: The MCP invocation cannot be cancelled after dispatch.

tools.description: Mark a Double Agent job stale and signal the worker to stop.
